messages:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up — Julian submitted a resignation notice yesterday, final day 2026-04-10. Hes a long-term contractor on the Payments squad. Need to lock down access, benefits/COBRA question, and laptop return plan.
Julian (Contractor): Yep, final day is 4/10. Happy to stay a couple extra days for handover if helpful.
Sara (Eng Manager): Appreciate the offer. Can we keep him for two hours on 4/13 for async Q&A? We have an integration ticket that still needs context.
Nina (People Ops): Two hours on 4/13 sounds fine — well confirm after IT windows.
Mike (IT): For deprovisioning, standard policy: disable SSO + VPN at EOD final day, revoke API tokens day after. If manager needs short-term read-only access for the project, we can create a temporary service account. Need ticket with requested expiration.
Sara (Eng Manager): Please create temp service account for project-payments-readonly expiring 2026-05-01.
Mike (IT): Noted. Ill open the ticket and post the ticket ID here. 
it-automation-bot: Created ticket IT-4892 for service account creation (owner: Mike). ETA 1 business day.
Asha (Benefits): Quick clarifying Q: Julian is a 1099 contractor and enrolled through our contingent worker plan — we dont offer COBRA to 1099s. He may have a vendor-specific supplemental plan; I can check the vendor portal. Julian, do you recall enrolling via the vendor or through Redwood payroll?
Julian (Contractor): I signed up through ContractCo benefits portal last year (they handled enrollment). I thought COBRA was automatic but if not that's fine — thanks for checking.
Asha (Benefits): Ok that matches what I expected. Ill message ContractCo and confirm end-of-coverage date; if the vendor supports continuation, well share next steps and the COBRA-like form. Expect update by EOD 4/6.
Nina (People Ops): Logistics checklist: 1) exit interview (calendar link below), 2) laptop return instructions + prepaid label, 3) license transfers (JetBrains, Figma), 4) access deprov timeline, 5) invoice finalization.
Nina (People Ops): Exit interview: please pick a slot here: https://calendar.redwood.com/people-ops/exit — aim for week of 4/6.
Julian (Contractor): Booked 4/7 10:00 with Nina.
Mike (IT): Laptop return — send to IT Returns: 123 Infra Way, Suite 4. Please follow these steps: 
```
1) Backup and wipe personal files.
2) Sign out of GitHub + Slack.
3) Remove SSH keys from profile: `ssh-keygen -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa -p` (or delete keys).
4) Place device in original box and use prepaid label.
```
Nina (People Ops): Ill email the prepaid label and confirmation link tonight.
Sara (Eng Manager): On licenses — I need to keep the Figma files. Nina, can you request license transfer for one file-owner to me?
Nina (People Ops): Will request transfer for Figma and JetBrains; well free up licenses upon return.
Mike (IT): Quick note: Julian still has a service token for the CI runner in payments-ci. Please run `aws iam list-access-keys --user julian-ci` and rotate if needed. I will revoke after 4/10 EOD unless Sara asks otherwise.
Sara (Eng Manager): Please revoke 4/10 EOD. If we need access, well use the temp service account.
Julian (Contractor): I can drop a short README in the repo and mark which CI jobs require manual trigger.
Nina (People Ops): Invoice and final pay: Julian, please submit your last invoice by 4/5 so Finance can process for the 4/15 run.
Julian (Contractor): Invoice will be in by COB 4/5.
Asha (Benefits): Update: ContractCo confirmed vendor coverage ends 4/30; they provided an enrollment link for continuation. Ill DM Julian the vendor form.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks Asha. Final items for closure: 
- IT to post ticket ID when service account is created. 
- Mike to confirm deprovision timeline (disable SSO 4/10 EOD, tokens revoked 4/11).
- Nina to send prepaid label + exit calendar invite confirmation.
- Sara to confirm any docs that must be transferred to eng wiki.
- Finance to expect invoice by 4/5.
Mike (IT): Confirming deprov timeline and will post when completed.
it-automation-bot: IT-4892 updated: service account created (project-payments-readonly), expires 2026-05-01.
Sara (Eng Manager): Ill move docs to the Payments wiki and tag the files with new owner.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks everyone — looping in Finance in case they need anything. Julian, well run exit interview on 4/7 then finalize closure items. :handshake:
Julian (Contractor): Appreciate the coordination — happy to help make handoff clean.
Nina (People Ops): Closing note: if anyone needs a record, Ill paste final checklist once IT and Benefits confirm.
